comment: # Offline: every command below runs under this macOS sandbox profile (no internet, localhost only)
# The published v2 Q4_K_M file, with greedy decoding as in the benchmark

run: sandbox-exec -f scripts/offline/offline.sb ollama create ggh-v2-greedy -f scripts/offline/Modelfile 2>&1 | tail -1

show: sed -n 4p sample.txt   # the question; 10 numbered abstract sentences follow

run: sandbox-exec -f scripts/offline/offline.sb ollama run --think=false --nowordwrap ggh-v2-greedy "$(cat scripts/offline/sample.txt)" 2>/dev/null
